description: We are a team of enthusiastic B.Tech CSE students passionate about technology, space, and innovation. We aim to use NASA's open data to develop creative solutions to real-world problems. We welcome motivated team members interested in coding, research, data analysis, design, and problem-solving. Beginners who are eager to learn, share ideas, and collaborate are welcome. Let's innovate together!
summary: EarthSong is an interactive web application that transforms real-time and historical Earth observation data into an engaging audio-visual experience. By using NASA Earth data, the platform converts environmental parameters such as temperature, humidity, wind speed, and other climate indicators into unique musical sounds through data sonification. Users can explore environmental conditions through interactive visualizations, charts, and sound patterns, making complex scientific information easier to understand and experience. The application aims to bridge the gap between scientific data and public awareness by presenting Earth's changing conditions in a creative, accessible, and engaging way. EarthSong encourages users to explore our planet from a different perspective — not just by seeing Earth's data, but by listening to it.
details:
EARTHSONG is an innovative interactive web application developed to transform Earth's environmental data into an immersive audio-visual experience. It uses NASA POWER data to explore important environmental parameters such as air temperature, relative humidity, and wind speed.

The application presents environmental information through interactive charts and visualizations using Chart.js. Its most unique feature is data sonification, which converts environmental values into musical sounds using the Web Audio API. This allows users to not only visualize Earth's changing environmental conditions but also listen to them.

Developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, EARTHSONG provides a simple and engaging interface with location selection and automatic data updates. The project aims to make complex Earth science data easier to understand, improve environmental awareness, and make scientific information accessible through creativity and technology.

By combining NASA Earth data, visualization, and sound, EARTHSONG offers a creative way to experience the planet's voice.
